docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Charles Wilkins’s English version of the Bhagavadgītā, the first translation of a Sanskrit work into a European language directly from the original, with Warren Hastings’s letter to the Company’s chairman and Wilkins’s preface (London, 1785). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Bhagavat Geeta Or Dialogues Of Kreeshna And Arjoon · Wilkins Charles · 1785, 164 scanned pages. Published 1785; Charles Wilkins died 1836 and Warren Hastings (letter) 1818; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
